title: Q-ASHBY-basic: dispose of Ashby keyword Basic pattern
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** ashbyarchive pass: Ashby's keyword "Basic pattern" (27 references, pages 36, 138, 141, 156, 159, 175, 193, 206, 210, 218, 228, 230 ...) shares pages with the systems categories and has no disposition
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ashbyarchive --probe basic
**Prediction:** archive_triaged_share >= 1.0 within 720 h
**Out of scope:** copying the journal's wording into the repository; marking a keyword not-applicable without a reason a reader can check
**Status:** closed

Read the cited pages (https://ashby.info/journal/index/index.html#basic; page images at https://ashby.info/journal/page/NNNN.html, transcribed summaries at https://ashby.info/journal/summaries) and dispose of the keyword in doctrine/ashby-archive.json: add it to a principle (our own statement, the pages, the code that carries it, a probe), or to `not_applicable` with the reason. A principle whose code does not exist yet is status item, with its own item.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ashbyarchive --probe basic`

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-27T17:23:13Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
